newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev eases to 1,500-1,507 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev eases to 1,500-1,507 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev eased to 1,500-1,507 per dollar on Friday afternoon from 1,495-1,500 at mid-morning due to a rise in dollar demand from final clients on the interbank market, dealers said.
"Some fuel and energy importers started bidding for foreign currency, pressuring the lev by some five (levs) against the dollar from its midday levels," a commercial bank dealer said.
Trade remained thin despite the rise in dollar demand, dealers said. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
